svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

text.tspan: WRITE PATH ABOVE · READ PATH BELOW

svg.text: the queue: one row per message
journal_events: append-only, seq contiguous per session.
A lane that starts over gets a new generation; clients reset.
until a receipt: transcript echo | hook with commandId
receipt window ended | CLI exited during the write
no rewrite (S1); holds the queue until resolved
failed | cancelled are final. preparing → failed after 3 min of CLI_BUSY.
event or read: direction of data
S1 at most one write per message · S3 one turn at a time (docs/DELIVERY.md §2)
